worlds.name: Training Camp
worlds.blurb: Warm up. Beat the boss to open every world.

levels.title: Every Clue
levels.tipText: Welcome to Training Camp! Tap the ear when you are ready. Wait until I finish talking. Then do what I said.

levels.title: Two Steps
levels.tipText: Two things to do now. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

levels.title: Tricky Words
levels.tipText: Listen for the tricky words: not, all, except, next to, left, and right.

levels.title: Before and After
levels.tipText: Before and after. Sometimes I say it backwards. Think: what comes first?

levels.title: Captain's Orders
levels.tipText: Only do it if it is a real order. If it is not, tap the hand.

levels.title: Camp Boss
levels.tipText: Camp Boss! Three and four steps, tricky words, and changes of plan. Beat me to open every world.

worlds.name: Memory Mountain
worlds.blurb: Long orders. Hold every step in your head.

levels.title: Three Colors
levels.tipText: Welcome to Memory Mountain! Three things to tap, and the colors matter. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

levels.title: Four Steps
levels.tipText: Four steps now. Here is a trick: count them on your fingers while I talk. Then tap one thing for each finger.

levels.title: Three From Memory
levels.tipText: Three steps with colors again. But now the cards are hidden while I talk. Listen first. Make a picture of each one in your mind. Then look.

levels.title: Five Steps
levels.tipText: Five steps! Take a breath. Say the list back in your head, like a little song. Then tap them one at a time.

levels.title: Backwards
levels.tipText: Opposite order means backwards. If I say the key, the gem, and the star, you tap the star first, then the gem, then the key. Start with the last thing I said.

levels.title: Skip and Count
levels.tipText: Two new tricks. If I say, skip the second one, leave out the second thing I said. And listen for how many times to tap each thing. Once, two times, or three times.

levels.title: The Summit
levels.tipText: The top of the mountain! Six steps in a row. And sometimes four hidden things, with a size and a color for each one. Breathe, listen to the end, and picture them.

levels.title: Summit Boss
levels.tipText: Summit boss! Backwards lists, skipping, counting, and six steps. Listen all the way to the end. Then go one step at a time.

worlds.name: Logic Lab
worlds.blurb: Think it through: count, compare, unless, only if.

levels.title: Count the Places
levels.tipText: Welcome to the Logic Lab! Everything is in one row. Count along the row to find the right one. Listen for which side to start from: the left, or the right.

levels.title: Neighbors
levels.tipText: Now some things look the same. Listen for what is beside each one. Next to. Between. To the left of. Only one of them fits.

levels.title: Groups
levels.tipText: Now think about groups. Things you can wear, like a hat or a ring. Animals, like a cat. Things that can fly. Tap every one that fits. Then press the green check mark.

levels.title: Two Clues at Once
levels.tipText: Two clues at once. Red and small means it must be both. Neither blue nor big means it is not blue, and it is not big. Tap all that fit. Then the green check mark.

levels.title: Count and Compare
levels.tipText: Time to count and compare. Count each kind first. Are there more, or fewer, or just as many? Then decide what to tap.

levels.title: Unless and Only If
levels.tipText: Tricky words: unless, and only if. Tap the star, unless there is a dragon. So if you see a dragon, do not tap anything. Press the hand instead.

levels.title: Two Orders
levels.tipText: I will give you two orders, but only one is right. Check what is true. Then do only that one, in the right order, and press the green check mark.

levels.title: Lab Boss
levels.tipText: Lab boss! Count, compare, unless, and only if. Think before you tap. If there is nothing you should do, press the hand.

worlds.name: Move and Pack
worlds.blurb: Pick things up and put them where I say.

levels.title: Into the Chest
levels.tipText: Welcome to Move and Pack! Tap a thing to pick it up. Then tap the place where it goes. When you have finished, press the green check mark.

levels.title: Two Trips
levels.tipText: Two things to move now. Listen for the color or the size, and for where: in, on, or under. Made a slip? Tap the thing to take it out again.

levels.title: Count Them
levels.tipText: Now listen for how many. If I say three coins, move three. Not two, and not four. Count what is inside before you press the green check mark.

levels.title: Sort It Out
levels.tipText: Sorting time! All means every single one. Everything red means every red thing, whatever it is. And except means that one stays on the shelf.

levels.title: First Things First
levels.tipText: Now the order matters. Listen for first, then, before, and after. Sometimes I say it backwards. So stop and think: which one do I move first? The little numbers show your order.

levels.title: Only If
levels.tipText: Now there is an if. Look at the shelf before you move anything. And if there is nothing you should move, tap the hand.

levels.title: Pack from Memory
levels.tipText: Memory time! Everything hides while I talk. Say the list back in your head. Then pack it all, and press the green check mark.

levels.title: Pack Boss
levels.tipText: Pack Boss! Orders, ifs, and packing from memory, all mixed up. Stop and think before you move. Beat me to clear this world.

worlds.name: Paint Shop
worlds.blurb: Grab a paint pot and color things just the way I say.

levels.title: First Coat
levels.tipText: Welcome to the Paint Shop! Tap a paint pot, then tap the thing to paint it. When it looks right, press the green check mark.

levels.title: Two Colors
levels.tipText: Two paint jobs now. Made a slip? Tap the sponge with the bubbles, then the thing, to wash it clean. Or press the arrow to take it back.

levels.title: Big and Small
levels.tipText: Now listen for big or small. Two things can look the same, so the size tells you which one to paint.

levels.title: All But One
levels.tipText: Tricky words: ALL and EXCEPT. All means every one that fits. Except means leave that one alone, with no paint at all.

levels.title: In a Row
levels.tipText: Now they stand in one row. The row starts on the left, like reading. Listen for where: second, last, in the middle, between, next to.

levels.title: Not and If
levels.tipText: Listen for NOT, IF, and UNLESS. They tell you which things get paint, and which things you must leave alone.

levels.title: Paint by Memory
levels.tipText: Now the things are hidden while I talk, and there are three or four paint jobs. Say each one back in your head. Then paint.

levels.title: Paint Boss
levels.tipText: Paint Boss! Rows, tricky words, and painting from memory, all mixed up. Listen all the way to the end.

worlds.name: Robot Workshop
worlds.blurb: Build the robot I describe, part by part.

levels.title: Two Parts
levels.tipText: Welcome to the Robot Workshop! I tell you what the robot looks like. Tap one picture in each row to build it. When your robot is ready, tap the green check mark.

levels.title: Three Parts
levels.tipText: Now the robot needs three parts. Listen to all of them before you start. Picked the wrong one? Tap another picture in that row, or tap the arrow to take it back.

levels.title: Not That One
levels.tipText: Listen for the word not. Sometimes I only tell you what the robot does not have. Then look along the row and work out which picture is left.

levels.title: How Many
levels.tipText: Now listen for numbers. How many eyes, how many antennas, how many buttons? Each number belongs to one part, so do not mix them up.

levels.title: Longest and Most
levels.tipText: Now you have to compare. Listen for words like longest, bigger, more and fewer. Look along the whole row before you choose.

levels.title: Twisted Orders
levels.tipText: These are tricky. I may say the parts in a mixed up order, give you a rule to work out, or ask for the first or last picture in a row. Listen to every word, think, then build.

levels.title: Blind Build
levels.tipText: Now the pictures stay hidden while I talk. Listen to all five parts and keep them in your head. Build the robot when the pictures turn over.

levels.title: Workshop Boss
levels.tipText: The Workshop Boss! Hard robots, tricky words and some hidden pictures. Take your time. Listen to the very end, then build.

worlds.name: Map Routes
worlds.blurb: Steer the rover the way the voice says.

levels.title: First Drive
levels.tipText: Steer the rover with the four big arrows. Up, down, left and right mean the directions on the screen. One tap moves one square. Then press the green check mark.

levels.title: Turn the Corner
levels.tipText: Now the route has a turn in it. Drive the first part, then turn and drive the next part. Made a slip? The arrow at the bottom of the screen takes one move back.

levels.title: Landmarks
levels.tipText: Now I name a place on the map. Drive the rover there any way you like, and stop on its square. Then press the green check mark.

levels.title: Road Trip
levels.tipText: Now there are stops on the way. Drive to each place in the order I say, and finish on the last one. You can see a number on every place you have been.

levels.title: Rules of the Road
levels.tipText: Now there are rules. Do not touch means: never drive onto that square. To pick a thing up, drive over it. Listen for the words not and only.

levels.title: Tricky Orders
levels.tipText: Tricky orders! Sometimes I say the last stop first. Sometimes the map decides where you go. Think before you drive: what comes first?

levels.title: Memory Route
levels.tipText: Long routes from memory! The map hides while I talk. Say the route in your head, then drive it. The round arrow lets you hear it one more time.

levels.title: Route Boss
levels.tipText: Route Boss! Rules, tricky orders and long routes from memory. Take your time, and think before you drive.

worlds.name: Control Room
worlds.blurb: Buttons, switches, dials and secret codes. Work the spaceship.

levels.title: Push and Flip
levels.tipText: Welcome to the Control Room! Round buttons are for pressing. Switches flip up and down. Listen for the color, and for button or switch. Then do it.

levels.title: How Many Times
levels.tipText: Now listen for how many times, and for two things in order. Little dots count your presses. When you are done, press the green check mark. The arrow takes one back.

levels.title: The Dial
levels.tipText: Here is the dial. It shows one number. The plus button makes the number go up. The minus button makes it go down. Set it to the number I say.

levels.title: Secret Codes
levels.tipText: Now the number pad. I will tell you a code. Type the numbers in the same order. The little screen shows what you typed. The big rocket button is launch.

levels.title: Long Orders
levels.tipText: Longer orders now. Codes with five numbers, and three things to do in a row. Say them in your head while you listen. Keep them in the same order.

levels.title: Tricky Talk
levels.tipText: Tricky words now. Before and after can be said backwards. Except means leave that one out. Backwards means start with the last number. Think first, then press.

levels.title: Blackout
levels.tipText: Blackout! The controls stay covered while I talk, so remember everything. Sometimes the light decides what you do. Look at it when the cover opens.

levels.title: Control Room Boss
levels.tipText: Control Room Boss! Long codes, tricky words, and covered controls. Listen to every word. Then take your time and check your work before the green check mark.

worlds.name: Truth Detector
worlds.blurb: True, or not true? Look, listen and decide.

levels.title: True or Not
levels.tipText: Look at the picture and listen to what I say about it. If it is true, tap the green check mark. If it is not true, tap the cross.

levels.title: Count Them
levels.tipText: Now you have to count. It is only true if the number is exactly right. When I have finished talking, you can touch the things in the picture to mark them as you count.

levels.title: All, None, Some
levels.tipText: Listen for three little words. All means every single one. None means not even one. Some means a few of them. Check each one in the picture.

levels.title: More or Fewer
levels.tipText: Now we compare. More means a bigger number. Fewer means a smaller number. As many means the very same number. Look at both groups before you choose.

levels.title: Where Is It
levels.tipText: Everything stands in one row now. Listen for where things are: next to, between, left, right, the end, and the middle. Find the place, then choose.

levels.title: Two Facts
levels.tipText: Now I say two things in one sentence. Check them both. Listen for the little words that change everything: and, but, not, either, neither, and except.

levels.title: Master Detective
levels.tipText: The hardest test. The picture is covered while I talk, so hold the whole sentence in your head. It has two parts, and both must be true. Then look, count and choose.

levels.title: Truth Boss
levels.tipText: Truth Boss! Rows, two facts at once, and covered pictures. Listen to every word, check every part, and then decide. You can do it.

worlds.name: Story Cave
worlds.blurb: Long stories. Who, when, where, and why.

levels.title: Who Has What
levels.tipText: Welcome to Story Cave! Listen to the whole story. Keep track of who has what, because things get swapped. Then tap the answer to my question.

levels.title: What Happened When
levels.tipText: Now listen for the order things happen in. I will ask what came right before, or right after. Tap the thing from that part of the story.

levels.title: Where Did It Go
levels.tipText: In these stories, things get moved around. Follow every move, like a movie in your mind. Then tap where the thing is, or who has it.

levels.title: Why Did It Happen
levels.tipText: Now I will ask why something happened. Many things are in the story, but only one of them caused it. Tap the thing that made it happen.

levels.title: Story Detective
levels.tipText: Be a detective. I will never say the name of the answer. Listen to every clue, and rule out what does not fit. Then tap what it must be.

levels.title: In or Out
levels.tipText: Two new jobs. Sometimes, tap the one thing that was not in the story. Sometimes, tap everything on my list, and then press the green check mark.

levels.title: Tell It Back
levels.tipText: The hardest stories. Tap the things in the order they really happened. Then press the green check mark. The arrow takes back a slip. Listen to the very end. Plans can change!

levels.title: Story Boss
levels.tipText: Story Boss! Clues, lists, and stories told out of order. Make a movie in your mind, and listen all the way to the end.

worlds.name: Legend Trials
worlds.blurb: Everything, mixed up. For true legends.

levels.title: Trial One
levels.tipText: Legend Trial one. A different challenge every turn. Listen to every word.

levels.title: Trial Two
levels.tipText: Legend Trial two. Stay calm, breathe, and listen all the way to the end.

levels.title: The Legend
levels.tipText: The final boss. Only the hardest challenge from every world. You are ready.

worlds.name: Rookie Camp
worlds.blurb: One thing at a time. Listen for every clue.

levels.title: Name It
levels.tipText: Welcome to Rookie Camp! Here is how it works. Tap the ear when you are ready to listen. Wait until I finish talking. Then tap what I said.

levels.title: Color It
levels.tipText: Now listen for the color. Some of them look the same, so the color tells you which one.

levels.title: Big or Small
levels.tipText: This time, listen for big or small.

levels.title: Two Clues
levels.tipText: Two clues now: the color, and the thing. You need both.

levels.title: Three Clues
levels.tipText: Three clues! The size, the color, and the thing. Here is a trick: say it back in your head.

levels.title: Wait For It
levels.tipText: Sometimes the important part comes at the very end. Keep listening until I stop talking.

levels.title: Camp Challenge
levels.tipText: Camp challenge! A mix of everything you have learned so far.

worlds.name: Two-Step Trail
worlds.blurb: Two things to do, in the right order.

levels.title: This, Then That
levels.tipText: Two things to do now. Tap them in the order I say. Then press the green check mark. Made a slip? The arrow takes it back.

levels.title: Two Colors
levels.tipText: Two steps, with colors. Here is a trick: make a picture of each one in your mind.

levels.title: How Many
levels.tipText: Listen for how many times.

levels.title: Listen, Then Look
levels.tipText: This time the cards are hidden while I talk. Listen first, hold it in your head, then look.

levels.title: Memory Trail
levels.tipText: Two steps, and the cards are hidden. Say them back in your head while you wait.

levels.title: Trail Boss
levels.tipText: Trail boss! Two steps, counting, and hidden cards, all mixed up.

worlds.name: Word Woods
worlds.blurb: Tricky words: not, all, except, next to.

levels.title: Not That One
levels.tipText: Tricky word alert: NOT. Listen for the one I do not want.

levels.title: All of Them
levels.tipText: When I say ALL, tap every one that fits. Then press the green check mark.

levels.title: All Except
levels.tipText: Tricky word: EXCEPT. Except means: leave that one out.

levels.title: Where Is It
levels.tipText: Now listen for where things are. Next to. Between. In the middle.

levels.title: Left and Right
levels.tipText: Left and right. Here is a trick: hold up both hands with your thumbs sticking out. The hand that makes an L is your left.

levels.title: Woods Wizard
levels.tipText: Woods challenge! Not, all, except, and where. Listen for the tricky word.

levels.title: First and Then
levels.tipText: First, then, last. These words tell you the order.

levels.title: After That
levels.tipText: Listen for the word AFTER.

levels.title: Before
levels.tipText: Listen for the word BEFORE.

levels.title: Flip It: Before
levels.tipText: Careful! Sometimes I say it backwards. Before you eat, wash your hands. So washing comes first. Listen for BEFORE, and think: what comes first?

levels.title: Flip It: After
levels.tipText: Careful again. Eat after you wash your hands. Washing still comes first. Listen for AFTER, and think: what comes first?

levels.title: Tower Boss
levels.tipText: Tower boss! Before and after, all mixed up. Think: what happens first?

levels.title: Captain Says
levels.tipText: Captain’s rule: only do it if I say, Captain says. If I do not say Captain says, tap the hand.

levels.title: Who Said It
levels.tipText: Sneaky pirates are giving orders too. Only listen to the captain.

levels.title: Only If
levels.tipText: IF is a tricky word. If it is true, do it. If it is not true, tap the hand.

levels.title: If Not
levels.tipText: Now there are two choices. If it is true, do the first thing. If not, do the second.

levels.title: Change of Plan
levels.tipText: Sometimes I change my mind at the end. Wait until I have completely finished.

levels.title: Captain's Test
levels.tipText: Captain’s test! Wait for every word before you move.

levels.title: Three Steps
levels.tipText: Three steps now. Here is a trick: count them on your fingers as you listen.

levels.title: Three With Colors
levels.tipText: Three steps, with colors. Say them back in your head.

levels.title: Three From Memory
levels.tipText: Three steps, and the cards are hidden. You can do it. Picture each one.

levels.title: Four Steps
levels.tipText: Four steps! Take a breath, listen all the way, and go one at a time.

levels.title: Mountain Boss
levels.tipText: Mountain boss! Long instructions. Breathe, listen, and go one step at a time.

worlds.name: Story Corner
worlds.blurb: Listen to a story, then answer.

levels.title: Who and What
levels.tipText: Story time! Listen to the story, then answer my question.

levels.title: Remember the Details
levels.tipText: These stories are a bit longer. Make a movie in your mind as you listen.

levels.title: What Happened First
levels.tipText: Listen for what happens first, next, and last.

levels.title: Story Detective
levels.tipText: Be a detective. I will not tell you the answer. Use the clues to work it out.

levels.title: Cave Boss
levels.tipText: Cave boss! Stories and clues. Make a movie in your mind.

levels.title: Hero Mix
levels.tipText: Hero’s Trial, part one. Clues, steps, and tricky words.

levels.title: Champion Mix
levels.tipText: Hero’s Trial, part two. Wait for the real order, and remember every step.

levels.title: Legend Run
levels.tipText: The Legend Run. Everything you have learned. You are ready.
